## Foxora AI v4.0.1 — refresh

This is a **same-version refresh** of v4.0.1, not a feature bump. The bits in the .app changed materially; the version label is unchanged so existing installs land cleanly on the new artifact via manual reinstall.

**Engine bundling.** The .app now contains the full `foxora-engine` runtime — 22,996 files / 312 MB tree — under `Contents/Resources/foxora-engine/`. Previous v4.0.1 builds shipped without it and depended on the dev tree; from this build forward, the .app is self-contained.

**Mastra → foxora-engine rename.** Internal directory names and Rust-side lookup paths now use `foxora-engine` instead of `mastra` (the framework class is still upstream `Mastra` — only our local paths changed). The shell looks for `$RESOURCES/foxora-engine/index.mjs` at launch.

**Native modules signed.** Six embedded native binaries (`.node` for `@libsql/darwin-arm64`, `better-sqlite3`, `fsevents`; `.bare` for `bare-fs`/`bare-os`/`bare-url`) now get a Developer ID signature before notary submission. Foreign-arch prebuilds (iOS simulator, Android, Windows, Linux) are pruned at stage time — Apple notary previously rejected them as unsigned.

**Updater key rotation.** The minisign pubkey baked into the app changed from `DE0AEE70D2308ABB` to `D492E3724E1D8E20`. The previous private key was lost; rather than leave auto-update permanently broken, this build resets the channel with a fresh keypair that's been backed up. **Consequence: existing v4.0.1 installs must manually reinstall once** to receive future updates — auto-update from the old build is signature-incompatible with the new key. From v4.0.2 onward, auto-update is silent again.

**One-command publish.** `bun run publish:update <version>` now does the whole publish dance (tar stapled .app, sign with rotated key, push to `foxora-releases:main`, regenerate `latest.json`). Per-version notes can live at `docs/release-notes/v<VERSION>.md`.

— xBesh Labs, LLC
